must_fix.problem: v1 calls EventAccumulator/Reload without independently requiring complete TFRecord framing, length CRC32C, data CRC32C and exact EOF. Upstream RawEventFileLoader treats DataLossError as end-of-stream, while the upstream compatible reader raises that error on truncated/CRC-invalid records. Consequently core step completeness alone is insufficient to establish complete event-file integrity: a damaged tail after all core samples may be silently ignored by such a loader. Before/after SHA establishes the same bytes, not valid record framing.
must_fix.required_change: New immutable v2 must validate every original event record with both masked CRC32C values, exact declared lengths/framing and complete EOF before extraction; fail closed with original event, offset and diagnostics. Plotting must require and bind the resulting full-event integrity proof.
